build_pytorch3d_extension: build the pytorch3d CUDA or C++ extension module with optional FORCE_CUDA and CUB_HOME env vars
build_pytorch3d_no_ninja: build the pytorch3d extension without ninja by setting PYTORCH3D_NO_NINJA to 1
get_extensions_pytorch3d: get the list of CppExtension or CUDAExtension modules for pytorch3d compilation
get_existing_ccbin: get the existing ccbin compiler argument from a list of nvcc arguments
install_pytorch3d_package: install the pytorch3d package with fvcore and iopath dependencies via pip
